loop_blocks.description: CLIP: produces token-level features for the U-net's cross-attention. Frozen; run once and reused every sampling step.
loop_blocks.label: CLIP
loop_blocks.title: CLIP text encoder

loop_blocks.description: The working latent — a single slot the loop reads and rewrites each step. It is seeded once from the initial noise (z_T), overwritten every step by the scheduler's output (z_{t-1}), and read by the denoiser as the current z_t. 'z_t' and 'z_{t-1}' are this same slot at consecutive steps, not separate tensors — the two arrows feeding it are two writers at different times, not a sum.
loop_blocks.label: latent
loop_blocks.title: Latent state (z_t)

children.description: Input 3×3 convolution: lifts the 4-channel noisy latent to 320 feature channels. Declared by in_channels / block_out_channels[0].
children.title: Conv in

children.description: Group normalization then a SiLU activation, applied before each convolution so the conv sees a well-scaled signal. GroupNorm is fixed in the ResnetBlock2D class; the activation is resolved through the denoiser's act_fn input.
children.title: GroupNorm + SiLU

children.description: A 3×3 convolution (stride 1, padding 1): mixes each position with its spatial neighbours — the cell runs GroupNorm+SiLU → Conv 3×3 twice.
children.title: Conv 3×3

children.description: The linear-projected timestep embedding is added here (ResnetBlock2D: hidden_states = hidden_states + time_emb_proj(SiLU(temb))). This is the mechanism by which a UNet ResNet receives the current noise level — distinct from DiT/AdaLN, which gates normalization parameters. The projection adjusts the channel width to match the residual branch.
children.title: ⊕ Timestep embedding

children.description: Group normalization then a SiLU activation, applied before each convolution so the conv sees a well-scaled signal. GroupNorm is fixed in the ResnetBlock2D class; the activation is resolved through the denoiser's act_fn input.
children.title: GroupNorm + SiLU

children.description: A 3×3 convolution (stride 1, padding 1): mixes each position with its spatial neighbours — the cell runs GroupNorm+SiLU → Conv 3×3 twice.
children.title: Conv 3×3

children.description: The linear-projected timestep embedding is added here (ResnetBlock2D: hidden_states = hidden_states + time_emb_proj(SiLU(temb))). This is the mechanism by which a UNet ResNet receives the current noise level — distinct from DiT/AdaLN, which gates normalization parameters. The projection adjusts the channel width to match the residual branch.
children.title: ⊕ Timestep embedding

children.description: Group normalization then a SiLU activation, applied before each convolution so the conv sees a well-scaled signal. GroupNorm is fixed in the ResnetBlock2D class; the activation is resolved through the denoiser's act_fn input.
children.title: GroupNorm + SiLU

children.description: A 3×3 convolution (stride 1, padding 1): mixes each position with its spatial neighbours — the cell runs GroupNorm+SiLU → Conv 3×3 twice.
children.title: Conv 3×3

children.description: Adds the block's raw input back onto the convolved output — (input_tensor + hidden_states) / output_scale_factor. The bypass goes around the entire cell: norm1, SiLU, conv1, timestep injection, norm2, SiLU, conv2. When in/out channels differ a 1×1 conv adjusts the shortcut (conv_shortcut).
children.title: Residual add

children.description: GroupNorm+SiLU → Conv 3×3 → ⊕ timestep emb → GroupNorm+SiLU → Conv 3×3 → residual add (identity shortcut, or 1×1 conv when channels change). The timestep embedding is projected and added after the first conv, injecting the current noise level into the residual branch. 3 per stage (layers_per_block).

children.description: This layer's mixer type is known, but its internal forward graph was not resolved from source. No Q/K/V projections, softmax, recurrence, or state update are asserted.
children.title: Custom attention internals unresolved

children.description: Full bidirectional self-attention over the spatial latent tokens at this resolution. Click to open its Q/K/V structure.
children.title: Self-attention

children.description: The encoded prompt supplies the keys and values here — the latent tokens are the queries, this external text sequence is the K/V, which is what makes it cross-attention. The text encoders' features are concatenated to 768-d (see the 'Encoded text' source in the denoiser view for that concatenation).
children.title: Encoded text (K/V)

children.description: Cross-attention: queries from the latent tokens, keys/values from the encoded text prompt (dim 768) — where text conditioning enters the U-net. Click to see the text states feeding K/V.
children.title: Cross-attention (text)

children.description: The gated FFN mechanism is proven, but its projection storage is not. The drill stays opaque instead of choosing split, fused, or dense modules.
children.label: Feed-forward
children.title: Feed-forward (storage unresolved)

children.description: Position-wise GEGLU feed-forward sublayer, applied after attention. Its structure is read from the block class the config's block types name, not from a config field.
children.title: Feed-forward

children.description: A Transformer2D block — 1 layer(s), each running self-attention → text cross-attention → feed-forward. Where text conditioning enters.
children.title: Transformer block

children.description: Up-path resolution stage: concatenates the skip connection from the matching down stage, then 3 residual (ResNet) block(s) at 320 channels, each with a 1-layer text cross-attention Transformer2D. Declared by up_block_types / block_out_channels / layers_per_block / transformer_layers_per_block.
children.title: Up stage

children.description: The encoded text prompt supplies the keys/values to EVERY cross-attention stage — the down, mid and up CrossAttn blocks all read the same 768-d text states (in SDXL, the two CLIP encoders' features concatenated). The latent flows through the U vertically; this conditioning enters each cross-attention stage from the side. Click to see how the encoders combine. Declared by cross_attention_dim + the CrossAttn* block types.
children.title: Text conditioning

children.description: Output GroupNorm + SiLU + 3×3 convolution: normalises (conv_norm_out, GroupNorm over 320 channels), activates (conv_act, SiLU — resolved through the denoiser's act_fn input), then projects back to 4 channels — the predicted noise (ε̂). Declared by out_channels / norm_num_groups.
children.title: Conv out

loop_blocks.description: The network applied at every step: a 4-stage convolutional U-net (down → mid → up with skip connections) that takes the latent z_t (+ timestep + text conditioning) and predicts the noise. Each down stage halves the spatial resolution (the latent is 8× downscaled at the bottleneck) and each up stage doubles it back; the timestep modulates every ResNet, and text conditioning (dim 768) enters the cross-attention stages. Click to open its architecture.
